name: BooksToRead_no_va

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations about the books the people want to read in the future.

sound_effects_config.default_background: peaceful home environment with occasional low radio sounds

initial_prompt: Create a conversation where roommates discuss what books they want to read in the nearest future and they share ideas and preferences with each other.

variations.context: Discussing a recent book that was found to be interesting and making future plans

setting.mood: Light discussion with an upbeat tone
setting.relationship_dynamic: Roommates that have lived together for a long time now
setting.background: They use their home assistant to take notes about all the books they want to read in the future
setting.conversation_style: Excited about all the fun that awaits in the world of fiction

scenario_template.topic: A person shares they experience with reading an interesting book recently
scenario_template.note: Sharing their experience with the book No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.
